openQuestions.q: Must the canonical owner-session document be updated first and then both Codex and agy reviews rerun against the new hash before runtime code begins?
openQuestions.evidence: CHK-004 requires updating/confirming the canonical contract, but both PASS reviews bind current documentHash 04f744fa; the owner document requires reviews over the version implemented.
openQuestions.resolution: Yes. In DEV, CHK-004 lands the canonical owner-session document update first. The initial Codex+agy reviews are planning evidence only and become stale when the document changes. Recompute HEAD/material/document hashes and obtain two fresh independent real-host PASS reviews before any runtime source or test implementation begins.
